notes: Byte-identical copy of the repo's new.sas: reads sashelp.air (a built-in SAS sample dataset, so no external data needed), drops two variables (ID, ZWEI) that don't exist on the source data. Runs as-is; SAS emits WARNINGs (not ERRORs) for dropping never-referenced variables, which is standard, documented SAS behavior, so the script completes and writes the new dataset unchanged apart from the no-op drop.
